lane:
شبت

شِبِتٌّ [_Anethum graveolens,_ or _dill, of the common garden-species;_] _a certain herb,_ or _leguminous plant, well known:_ (K:) it is said that سِبِتٌّ is an arabicized word from شِبِتٌّ; but it has been stated before [in art. سبت, q. v.,] that both these are arabicized words from شِوِذْ [or شِوِدْ]; and that سبط [i. e. سِطٌّ] is a dial. var. (TA.) [See also شِبِثٌّ.]

entries.text: شبت: الشِّبِتُّ: نَبْتٌ؛ عَنْ أَبي حَنِيفَةَ، وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ الشِّبِتَّ معرّب عنه.
